details: bundle-entry-points has no functional code, and its description ("A utility for managing SVG buckets.") does not match its name. Its postinstall script runs `node index.js` on npm install, which POSTs a JSON beacon (`event: "authorized-poc-test"`, a random test id, `status: "executed"`) to `https://webhook.site/0a4d6535-e2dd-46b7-aff7-8af65c145c50`, revealing to the collector that the package was installed and from which network. It was published by the npm account djdhhdjdjf7777, which has no other packages; the same code, with a different webhook.site URL, was published as com.unity.external-dependency-manager by the account depipp777 on 2026-11-22.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
